correctness.rationale: For vertices in one part of size \(s\), the defect \(n-c_{xy}\) is \(s\); for vertices in distinct parts of sizes \(a,b\), it is \(a+b\). Counting same-part and cross-part pairs gives \(2F(z)=P(z)^2-z^2P' (z^2)+zP'(z)-P(z)\). With \(p_1=0\), the coefficient of \(p_s\) is \(s-1\) and every convolution term uses smaller indices, so the stated recurrence uniquely reconstructs all part multiplicities. The checked verifier code exactly implements this recurrence; an independent enumeration reproduced all \(5574\) multipartite types through order \(30\).
residual_risks: The theorem deliberately excludes singleton parts; the coefficient inversion does not determine \(p_1\) by the same triangular step.
